integrity: The statement and proof were checked analytically and against an independent geometric convex-hull program. Finite numerical tests are not proofs. Historical priority is provisional, and the known n=4 rectangular-base result is explicitly excluded.
scientific_limitations: Applies only to right pyramids over regular bases with n >= 5 and Haar-uniform orthogonal two-plane projections; no all-combinatorial-types law, arbitrary-base theorem, or independent mathematical audit.
title: Sharp full-silhouette probability and optimal height for regular polygonal pyramids
